[b][size=4]Description[/size][/b]
This mod adds magic mushrooms to forage in the secret woods. Find Wavy Caps, Liberty Caps, and Golden Halos, craft them into spawn, inoculate some logs and grow lots more shrooms! 

“And then what?” you might ask…

Dry them! Rather than contaminate your regular dehydrator, craft a special Shroom Drier to dry out your shrooms into potent ingredients. You can use them to make tea, chocolate and even a special Stardew Valley version of lemon tek made with mystic syrup. 

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]To install this mod, unzip the compressed file into your mods folder. Ensure you have all required mods. [/color]

The Shrooms:
Each shroom has custom foraging seasons, pricing, and edibility. Each one is needed for a different recipe, so be sure to collect all three.  They will appear in their respective seasons either during or after rain, storms and even snow.

The Logs:
Inoculation Logs allow you to cultivate shrooms so that you don’t have to wait for them to appear in the secret woods. To craft the logs you need hardwood and ok resin. Once you have foraged a shroom you can craft it into spawn and place that in the inoculation logs. The logs will produce 4 or 5 shrooms of the same type. Each shroom type takes a different amount of time to grow. 

The Drier
The Shroom Drier takes one shroom and puts out one dried version of that shroom. * To craft the drier you need wood, fire quartz and glass shards. Dried shrooms are needed to make the new recipes.

The Recipes
Shroom Tea is made with Wavy Cap shrooms and tea leaves. It gives a +1 foraging buff.
Shroom Chocolate is made with Liberty Cap shrooms, milk, and sugar. It gives a +1 luck buff.
Mystik Tek is made with Golden Halo shrooms and mystic syrup. It gives a +1 buff to both foraging and luck but a -1 debuff to speed.


*You may be wondering why I didn’t just make them dehydratable in the existing dehydrator, and you know what? I have asked myself the same question. Maybe in an update. Let me know if you’d prefer that. [/color]
